The Complete Season Four |publisher=[[Warner Bros.|Warner Home Video]] |release date=[[October 23]], [[2012]] {{C|US}}{{SW|url=news/the-clone-wars-season-4-available-october-23-on-blu-ray-and-dvd|text=''The Clone Wars'' Season 4 Available October 23 on Blu-ray and DVD|nolive=1}} |runtime=493 minutes |upc= |isbn= |media type=*Blu-ray disc *DVD |resolution=*1080p (Blu-ray disc) *480p (DVD) |ratio=2.35:1 |audio=English *DTS-HD Master Audio 5.1 |subtitles=English }} '''''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Four''' is a three-disc Blu-ray or four-disc DVD set of the [[2011]]–[[2012]] [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. It was released by [[Warner Bros.|Warner Home Video]] on [[October 23]], 2012. ==Contents== *All 22 episodes of [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|Season Four]]; Director's Cuts of "[[Carnage of Krell]]," "[[Escape from Kadavo]]," "[[Massacre]]," and "[[Bounty (episode)|Bounty]]" *Five Video Commentaries were included in the release: **"The Battle of Mon Cala" **"Darkened World of Umbara" **"[[The Slaves of Zygerria]]" **"Obi-Wan Undercover" **"Darth Maul Returns" *The "Jedi Temple Archives" feature exclusive to the Blu-ray version. The DVD version includes some hidden Easter eggs: (All under the Episodes option) *Disc One— Cover design evolution for 3D World magazine ([[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2's]] Leg) *Disc Two—Additional [[Darkness on Umbara]] commentary ([[Rex/Legends|Rex's]] chestplate) *Disc Three—[[The Clone Wars: Season Four]] trailer ([[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] pouch) *Disc Four—"He's Back" [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] teaser trailer ([[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage's]] necklace) ==Media== {{Mediacat|from=1|imagecat=Images from Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Four}} ===Editions=== *UPC 883929228812; [[October 23]], [[2012]]; [[Warner Bros.|Warner Home Video]]; US Blu-ray disc *UPC 883929229895; October 23, 2012; Warner Home Video; US DVD ===Cover gallery=== File:TCWS4-Bluray.jpg|Blu-ray disc File:TCWS4-DVD.jpg|DVD ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/the-clone-wars-season-4-available-october-23-on-blu-ray-and-dvd|text=''The Clone Wars'' Season 4 Available October 23 on Blu-ray disc and DVD|nolive=1}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{TheCloneWarsEpisodes}} {{Interlang |ka=ვარსკვლავური ომები: კლონების ომები: სრული მეოთხე სეზონი }} [[Category:Star Wars: The Clone Wars home video releases]]
